label: Necessary restrictions cannot determine a genuinely contingent represented fact
paraphrase: For every PSR arena, selected world and necessary basis, any condition depending only on the entire basis truth vector that actually obtains and entails a fact at every accessible world excludes that fact's contingency. If every accessible represented truth agrees with actuality, no represented fact is contingent. Determination is informational and truth-entailing, not causal or explanatory adequacy. The basis may be infinite; represented completeness, actual metaphysical accessibility and an explanatory interpretation are not supplied.
